generation.scope: A finite four-line incidence in the raw tensor detects exactly all standard windows admitting a regular normal linear sequence and recovers every marking, even where multiple marks exist. A ternary overlap and two projective matrix-rank tests certify every ternary base including nonreduced plane cubics. The unmarked elliptic quotient classification extends to nodal and cuspidal integral graphs; the projective centralizer is at most six in the nodal case and trivial in the cuspidal case.

open_mathematics: Analyze the complementary branch with neither a regular normal linear sequence nor a quantum limit. Develop finite recognition and all-degree criteria for normal quadrics or higher projective evaluation strata. Resolve the two-pair simultaneous quantum obstruction when explicit strata are needed.
